message.content: {"action":"change_rounding","reason":"All evaluated direct and symmetric_preadd points with coef_frac >= 12 already meet the 60 dB SQNR requirement, and the lowest-area passing point is symmetric_preadd at coef_frac 14. Precision decreases are exhausted or risky because coef_frac 10 direct fails, and architecture switching has already been explored. Changing rounding mode has 6 legal unvisited neighbors and may reduce mapped area while preserving the 60 dB quality constraint."}
